policy: This manifest prescribes future acceptance; it does not verify tasks or authorize automatic ChatGPT Send. Only evidence in progress.json changes verified counts.
execution_environment: Isolated Firefox Developer Edition on Linux; local Codex automation may perform repeated QA after legitimate one-time account setup.
privacy: Never commit credentials, conversation URLs, draft text, native reports or screenshots containing private material.

gates.title: Live upload control discovery
acceptance: Use a dedicated authenticated Firefox Developer Edition QA profile; do not modify the personal profile
Identify actual user-facing supported upload mechanism and verify changing application DOM rather than assuming static input[type=file] is sufficient
Record selector rationale and compatibility evidence without collecting conversation contents or credentials

gates.title: Correct-conversation report attachment
acceptance: Submit a single harmless Jobflick fixture and retrieve the actual bounded report with real Firefox Native Messaging
Prove same-tab exact-conversation File handoff and site acknowledgment of the exact report
Reject wrong tab, wrong report, changed upload target, and A-to-B-to-A origin reuse without transfer

gates.title: Actual site attachment confirmation
acceptance: Confirm the exact file is associated with the intended composer in authenticated Firefox; file-input changes alone do not qualify
Wait for authoritative UI acknowledgment and distinguish asynchronous rejection, delay and timeout
No automatic Send from attachment preparation or ambiguous acknowledgment

gates.title: Preserve drafts and existing attachments
acceptance: Reject occupied draft and prior attachments without modifying either
Preserve user edits made during pending upload and navigation
Verify no clipboard alteration, pasted full logs or unattended Send

gates.title: Draft-safe original-composer handoff
acceptance: Confirm original tab/session/conversation at each asynchronous boundary
Bind one unique composer and one file-input target; prove preserved draft and attachments
Prove orphaned or background-reloaded source falls back to manual delivery

gates.title: Separate guarded Send
acceptance: Require per-job separate automatic Send consent and verified attachment receipt
Persist send_requested before dispatch; allow at most one action and no automatic retry on ambiguous outcome
Confirm exact-origin revalidation at Send boundary and reject duplicate callbacks

gates.title: Guarded original-conversation routing
acceptance: Prove final Send targets only the originating conversation, not merely a matching URL or recycled tab ID
Exercise in-flight A-to-B-to-A, tab closure and Firefox restart
Preserve uncertain results in Jobflick for manual recovery without duplicate execution or Send

gates.title: Live multi-conversation delivery QA
acceptance: Run real signed-in Firefox Developer Edition acceptance matrix using harmless Jobflick jobs
Exercise 16 conversations, rerender, existing draft, wrong tab, offline native host and restart
Observe both attachment and Send receipts; record scrubbed evidence and negative cases

gates.title: End-to-end authenticated Firefox acceptance
acceptance: Complete non-synthetic Jobflick-to-ChatGPT report and guarded Send flow in dedicated authenticated Firefox QA profile
Verify no duplicate execution or delivery and isolated local profile safety
Record real acceptance evidence with no private conversation details in public repo

gates.title: Signed and permitted Firefox installation
acceptance: Pass immutable pre-signing evidence gate with every prerequisite task verified
Obtain actual Mozilla unlisted signature via explicit gated workflow, not an unsigned archive
Install signed XPI persistently in disposable Firefox Developer Edition and verify restart, Gecko ID and integrity

gates.title: Release provenance and SemVer
acceptance: Record accepted source SHA and signed XPI SHA-256 with changelog and SemVer
Review packaged contents for unexpected files, secrets and private text
Create tag/release only after every atomic task is verified and signing evidence is attached
